title: Tangent spaces of a hypersurface of A₀: T_xM = A₀ ∩ ν(x)^⊥ and P_x = Π_{A₀} − ν(x)⊗ν(x)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace with dim A₀ = m + 1, M ⊆ A₀ an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M), and ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with ν(x) ∈ A₀, |ν(x)| = 1 and ν(x)·v = 0 for all v ∈ tangentSpace M x, for every x ∈ M. Then for every x ∈ M: tangentSpace M x = {v ∈ A₀ : ν(x)·v = 0}, and for every w ∈ ℝ^P, (span tangentSpace M x).starProjection w = A₀.starProjection w − (ν(x)·w)ν(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → ∀ x ∈ M, tangentSpace M x = {v : Euclid P | v ∈ A₀ ∧ inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0} ∧ ∀ w : Euclid P, (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection w = A₀.starProjection w - inner ℝ (ν x) w • ν x
